note: BRK-03 tripped on earth fault after tree contact in the Nunia canal corridor.
KLT-02 tripped on overcurrent. Kulti trunk out.
MHS-07 out after a distribution transformer failed at Mohishila.
Peak consumers without supply confirmed at 9,200 across three feeders.
BRK-03 re-energised after the Nunia corridor spans were restrung.
MHS-07 restored after transformer replacement at Mohishila.
KLT-02 restored to the Kulti trunk. Laterals remain out.
Remaining outages are individual service connections on the Kulti laterals.
Outage management system link remained available for the whole event and consumer counts were recorded continuously.
